name: SD: A bakery that runs out of flour (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A bakery's orders waiting, loaves ready for pickup, day-old bread and flour in the store, counted every hour. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-bakery/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests a co-flow: every loaf baked uses half a kilo of flour, so when the supplier is slow and the flour runs out, baking stops and orders pile up.
